overview: The Council requested a comprehensive financial audit of the Park Medford parking contract and a status update on anticipated federal funding from the American Rescue Plan. The body also voted to demand the reinstatement of the MBTA 710 bus route and referred a discussion on preserving expiring affordable housing units to a committee.

items.title: COVID-19 and Vaccination Update
items.summary: Health Director MaryAnn O'Connor reported a rise in COVID-19 cases among residents under 30 and provided updates on homebound vaccination efforts and the potential for a mass vaccination site at Tufts University.

items.title: 38 Harvard Avenue Auto Body License
items.summary: Approved a Class 4 auto body license for Mallet Fantasia Auto and Auto Body Repair, subject to a final zoning review by the Building Commissioner.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Construction Update
items.summary: Councilors requested a progress report on aesthetic coverage for the hospital's cooling tower and scheduled a review of lighting commitments for 90 days after the new facility opens.

items.title: MBTA Route 710 Service Reinstatement
items.summary: Approved a resolution calling for the MBTA to reinstate the 710 bus route serving Fulton Heights and requested updates on the status of the 325 and 326 routes.

items.title: American Rescue Plan Funding Update
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide the Council with an update on expected local aid from federal rescue funds and its potential impact on the upcoming city budget.

items.title: Expiring Affordable Housing Units
items.summary: Referred a discussion to the Committee of the Whole regarding the preservation of 38 subsidized housing units in Medford set to expire by 2025.

items.title: Park Medford Financial Accounting Request
items.summary: The Council requested all annual financial reports and records of unpaid revenue balances from Park Medford dating back to the contract's inception in 2015.

items.title: Committee Reports and Board of Appeals Expansion
items.summary: Introduced new Economic Development Director Victor Schrader and referred a proposal to increase the Board of Appeals membership from three to five to the Community Development Board.
